scope: Retire live NGE Build-a-Buff, general/TCG XP-buff progression, random fs_meditate_* bonuses, GCW point consumables, autonomous GCW consumable turrets, post-Publish-14 absolute player control-immunity buffs, later reactive avoid-incapacitation heals, direct Officer Inspiration/Last Words and Spy Perfect Opportunity heal effects, the exact seven-name Beast Master/Medic/Officer/Spy profession immunity and purge family, the queued-battlefield runner communication buff, and the exact inherited player group-aura, flat-HAM, and percentage-HAM buff sets that conflict with restored Publish 14.1 profession, Jedi, Squad Leader, stealth, and reward authority without removing later-content data compatibility, retained consumable and treasure heals, NPC group propagation, non-player pet cure behavior, or the restored Publish 14.1 entertainer, Teras Kasi, Creature Handler, cloning-sickness, innate regeneration/vitalize, Power Boost, QA, NPC encounter, and Jedi avoid-incapacitation lifecycles.

findings: Publish 14.1 entertainer attribute buffs are accumulated through dance/music watch and listen sessions and apply Mind, Focus, and Willpower pools.
Pinned Publish 14.1 Core3 contains no native Buff Builder, buildabuff_inspiration handler, general percentage-of-level XP buff, or TCG XP grant path.

The retained Build-a-Buff row, three TCG instant-XP-by-level rows, and seven TCG class-XP bonus rows now fail closed at the shared player admission boundary before persistence, status-icon creation, or generic click-item consumption; exact stale instances are removed by the existing login lifecycle while all eleven TCG items route through their authored collection fallback and rows, templates, and non-player compatibility remain loadable.
Publish 14.1 awards explicit profession XP types from combat, crafting, and performance activity rather than scaling them from an NGE 1-90 player level.
Later buff rows and effect mappings remain compatibility data so retained expansion assets can load while their post-NGE progression handlers fail closed.

Pinned Publish 14.1 Teras Kasi meditation reduces DOT strength and heals wounds; the inherited every-third-tick Force Sensitive branch that randomly granted fs_meditate_* expertise, resource-quality, or modified-primary-stat bonuses is retired.

The retained GCW banner's nine Roadmap class buffs apply NGE modified primaries, Luck, expertise modifiers, or a proc attack absent from pinned Publish 14.1 and therefore remain data-only compatibility rows.
The retained TCG HH-15 and rocket-launcher consumables grant post-NGE percentage GCW-point bonuses rather than a Publish 14.1 faction-point rule and now remain non-consuming compatibility items.

The retained mini-turret consumable handlers create autonomous 250-500 damage, 5000-health faction turrets from later GCW content; their item and buff rows remain loadable while player admission and turret creation fail closed.

Pinned Publish 14.1 resolves combat states through accuracy versus defender state-defense skill modifiers, including the separate Jedi resistance_states roll; it does not grant timed absolute player buffs that block whole snare, root, mez, daze, armor-break, slow, or action-drain groups.

The retained Mustafar movement/mez devices, treasure snare-immunity consumable, GCW critical-heal recourse, generic player immunity rows, and daze/mez/action-drain recourses remain loadable compatibility content while their player admission and stale state fail closed; boss and beast control behavior remains available.

Pinned Publish 14.1 has an authentic Jedi avoidIncapacitation command using the avoid_incapacitation skill modifier and a distinct avoid_incap buff effect; it has no generic avoid_incap_heal consumable callback that heals a player before the incapacitated posture is applied.

The five GCW reactive stim buffs, two last-man PvP buffs, and Tusken endurance heroic buff are the complete eight-row avoid_incap_heal inventory; their retained content rows remain loadable while player admission, stale state, and the pre-incap reactive-heal callback fail closed.

The sole avoid_incap_heal effect mapping dispatches through onIncapHealAddBuffHandler. Generic admission and the reactive-heal consumer were already player-inert, but the direct add-side handler could still restore the later gcw_critical_heal script variable. It now runs central player cleanup and returns before mutation; remove-side cleanup and non-player expansion behavior remain available.

The retained Game Update 10 battlefield_communication_run row is persistent and dispatches through the sole battlefieldCommuncationsGlow mapping. Exact player-only admission and lifecycle cleanup plus an add-handler guard now prevent stale runner state from stripping invisibility or blocking retained PRE-CU stealth, while the row, mapping, remove cleanup, and non-player compatibility remain available.

The inherited attribPercent handler owns exactly 34 retained buff rows through six max-HAM percentage effects. Nineteen rows belong to removed NGE Doctor/Combat Medic/Jedi grants, replaced Squad Leader behavior, and later combat-reward buffs; exact player admission, persistence, and add-handler authority are retired while all rows and non-player compatibility remain available.

The remaining fifteen attribPercent rows are deliberate compatibility exceptions: authenticated PRE-CU Creature Handler emboldenPet and cloning sickness, QA frogBuff, retained Mustafar and Death Troopers mechanics, and creature-special effects. They remain outside the retired player-name inventory.

The inherited attrib handler owns exactly 33 retained buff rows through seven flat HAM effects. Thirteen rows are NGE level-gated holocron/force-crystal rewards, Mustafar crystal combat authority, Trials of Obi-Wan modified-primary rewards, or an unused NGE combat helper; exact player admission, persistence, and add-handler authority are retired while the authored content rows remain available.

The remaining twenty attrib rows are deliberate exceptions: pinned Publish 14.1 authenticates innate regeneration, innate vitalize, and Power Boost; fifteen rows are QA fixtures; and two encounter debuffs target NPCs. The generic non-player writer and unguarded removal cleanup remain available.

The sole group effect owns exactly 38 retained rows, all of which are post-Publish-14 player combat authority: ten NGE Squad Leader group replacements, Commando and Jedi expertise auras, an NGE veteran-level buff, twenty-five Officer combat buffs, and an NGE Human species combat buff.

Pinned Publish 14.1 Core3 implements Form Up as DIZZY/STUN removal, Rally as a 30-second weapon-accuracy and group-defense buff, and Retreat as a 30-second group burst run. Those mechanics use formup, rally, and retreat rather than any sl_group_*, Officer, expertise, veteran-level, or human_ability_1 row, so all 38 group rows remain content-compatible but fail closed for players while NPC propagation and removal cleanup remain available.

A whole production-script inventory has exactly one caller of grantUnmodifiedXPPercentageOfLevel: xpGrantedGeneralAddBuffHandler, which returns at the central retirement gate before the call; the retained API itself also returns zero without consulting player level, class template, or the NGE level table.

All ordinary and crafting inspiration-XP consumers resolve to identity or zero before retained percentage data can affect Publish 14.1 explicit XP pools, closing the deferred level-percentage buff-XP authority surface.

The exact seventeen-name post-NGE profession-inspiration family now owns general_inspiration cleanup through one player-only lifecycle helper, including all shared and name-scoped stale script-variable trees, while retained rows and non-player compatibility remain available.

The two retained healEffect mappings service thirteen rows and fifteen effect uses. Six Officer Inspiration rows, Officer Last Words, and Spy Perfect Opportunity account for the exact eight retired NGE player rows and nine direct heal uses; the handler now cleans their existing retired state and returns before either heal writer while five later-content rows and six uses remain available.

The five retained immunity mappings service ten rows and thirteen effect uses. Beast Master pet cure, four Medic rows, Officer stimulator, and Spy covert mastery account for the exact seven retired profession rows and ten uses; player admission, lifecycle cleanup, and the direct handler fail closed before DOT immunity, debuff purge, buff purge, movement immunity, buff reads, or script-variable mutation while three later-content rows and non-player pet cure execution remain available.
